# Startup Design Award

This llms.txt file is designed to help LLMs better understand and index this website. Startup Design Award provides information about the award, applications, jury, participating start-ups, gallery, participation requirements, and contact information.

## Pages

https://startupdesignaward.com/: Homepage providing an overview of the Startup Design Award and its purpose.

https://startupdesignaward.com/bewerbung/: Application page for start-ups interested in participating in the Startup Design Award.

https://startupdesignaward.com/jury/: Information about the Startup Design Award jury.

https://startupdesignaward.com/start-ups/: Information about participating start-ups.

https://startupdesignaward.com/galerie/: Gallery featuring Startup Design Award entries and related visual content.

https://startupdesignaward.com/kontakt/: Contact page for reaching the Startup Design Award team.

https://startupdesignaward.com/teilnahmebedingungen/: Terms and conditions for participating in the Startup Design Award.

https://startupdesignaward.com/datenschutz/: Privacy policy and data protection information.

https://startupdesignaward.com/impressum/: Legal notice and publisher information.
